cards.name: Sparky
cards.summary: Slow high-damage splash cannon. Wins games behind a tank; dies to reset + swarm.
strengths: Deletes tanks and medium swarms after charge
Huge tower damage if it connects
tips: Always place behind king to charge
Never let her cross alone — Giant must tank first
Save Zap for their reset if you can

cards.name: Giant
cards.summary: Building-targeting tank. The bridge for Sparky and support.
tips: Place in FRONT of Sparky before the bridge
Pair with Ice Wizard / Mega Minion / Princess behind
Don't bridge spam into Inferno

cards.name: Zap
cards.summary: Cheap stun + small splash. Your answer to swarms and Inferno reset.
strengths: Clears Bats, Goblin Barrel, skarmy chips
weaknesses: Overusing leaves you vulnerable to bait
tips: Vs Balloon+Bats: Zap the Bats first
Hold for Inferno reset when pushing Giant
Don't waste on single medium troop

cards.name: Princess
cards.summary: Long-range splash chip and swarm clear from a safe depth.
weaknesses: Dies to any medium troop in melee
tips: Place deep or opposite lane
Great behind Giant on counter-push
Don't drop at bridge into Log

cards.name: Ice Wizard
cards.summary: Slow + chip. Best defensive tempo card in this deck.
weaknesses: Dies to Fireball often with support
tips: Drop in front of threatened tower
Vs Balloon: slow + tower = win with air support
Walk behind Giant on offense

cards.name: Barbarians
cards.summary: Ground swarm DPS. Surround win conditions and tanks.
strengths: Melts Balloon on ground path if connected
tips: Place ON the path of the threat, not stacked on tower
Vs Balloon: drop slightly ahead of landing
Don't dump into Fireball bait

cards.name: Elixir Collector
cards.summary: Tempo investment. Wins long games if protected.
weaknesses: Dies if you pump under siege
tips: Only when lanes are calm
Behind king / safe tile
Never pump into live Balloon/X-Bow lock

cards.name: Mega Minion
cards.summary: Single-target flying DPS. Primary Balloon / air answer.
strengths: Strong vs Lava pups / mid HP air
tips: Vs Balloon: drop on its path ASAP
Pair Zap if Bats accompany
Support Giant from air

cards.name: Balloon
cards.summary: Death-damage air win condition. Connects = huge tower damage.
tips: Answer immediately with Mega Minion
Zap Bats first if stacked
Ice Wizard buys tower shots

cards.name: Bats
cards.summary: Cheap flying swarm. Melts single-target air answers if ignored.
tips: Always Zap or Princess when Bats stack on Balloon
Don't let them surround Mega Minion

cards.name: Hog Rider
cards.summary: Fast building-targeting bridge pressure.
tips: Pull with building or surround with Barbs
Ice Wizard slows for more tower shots

cards.name: X-Bow
cards.summary: Siege lock win condition. Only relevant if actually on the board.
tips: Tank into it (Giant)
Pressure opposite lane
Do not invent X-Bow if you only see chip

cards.name: Inferno Tower
cards.summary: Melts tanks. Hard counter to Giant/Sparky pushes if not reset.
tips: Zap reset before Giant connects
Distract with cheap swarm if needed

cards.name: Inferno Dragon
cards.summary: Air Inferno. Resets with Zap.
tips: Zap when beam is locked on Giant/Sparky

cards.name: Minion Horde
cards.summary: Heavy air swarm. Punishes unanswered tanks.
tips: Arrows/Fireball if available; else Princess + Zap

cards.name: Skeleton Army
cards.summary: Ground swarm surround.
tips: Zap immediately when dropped on Sparky/Giant

cards.name: Goblin Barrel
cards.summary: Bait spell to tower.
tips: Zap on prediction or as they land

cards.name: Lava Hound
cards.summary: Air tank beatdown. Pups after death.
tips: Focus Balloon first if stacked; Mega Minion on Hound otherwise

cards.name: Miner
cards.summary: Deploy-anywhere chip / tank for swarm.
tips: Ice Wizard / cheap swarm on king path

cards.name: Royal Giant
cards.summary: Ranged building-targeting tank.
tips: Surround with Barbs; Mega Minion from air

cards.name: P.E.K.K.A
cards.summary: Single-target ground nuke.
tips: Don't feed Sparky into PEKKA without swarm/Zap plan

cards.name: Golem
cards.summary: Heavy beatdown tank.
tips: Sparky on defense is excellent if protected from Zap

cards.name: Musketeer
cards.summary: Single-target ranged support.
tips: Fireball if stacked; Mega Minion trades well

cards.name: Baby Dragon
cards.summary: Flying splash.
tips: Mega Minion answers cleanly

cards.name: Freeze
cards.summary: Locks defenses so Balloon connects.
tips: Spread defenses so Freeze can't catch all
Keep a second air answer in hand

cards.name: Fireball
cards.summary: Medium spell. Punishes stacked support and Collector.
tips: Spread your Ice Wizard / Mega Minion
Expect Collector to be Fireballed

cards.name: The Log
cards.summary: Ground roll. Kills Princess / Goblin Barrel.
tips: Don't place Princess at bridge vs Log bait
